notes: Letterhead (organisation name and three address lines) is furniture, not a heading. "BILL TO" and "INVOICE DETAILS" are box labels (letter-spaced, uppercase in the source), not headings. The two boxes sit SIDE BY SIDE and read box by box: Bill to first, then Invoice details; the Invoice details box holds a borderless key/value table, which is not listed in tables. Line-item table: zebra bands, header row filled, Description cells are two lines (item + grey sub-line) joined by one space. Subtotal, VAT and Total rows are rows of the same table; their label cell spans four columns and is repeated four times. Payment-terms list: bullets drawn by CSS (disc, nested circle); markers are not in the text. The registration line at the bottom is a footer (furniture).
